concept: A hearty open-air feast kitchen where one warm oven and a few generous ingredients turn an ordinary meal into a small celebration.
main_structure: One compact cream-stone feast oven at the rear-left with a broad terracotta roof, a large arched fire opening, and one chunky chimney.
rear_props: one broad serving counter holding one large soup pot, one two-loaf basket, and one three-piece produce bowl
two broad amber kitchen lanterns flanking the rear work area
side_props: one chunky picnic bench and one oversized herb pot on the upper-left edge
one compact drink trolley with one large pitcher and one oversized herb pot on the upper-right edge

perimeter.material: one continuous smooth sage-green kitchen-garden border with broad rounded segments
perimeter.emblems: four oversized simple terracotta herb-leaf emblems

materials: a few broad warm cream stone blocks

lighting: soft warm daylight with one broad oven glow and two large amber lantern pools
must_keep: exact canonical camera, canvas, footprint, stairs, tapered underside, and padding
entire bottom/front half as quiet open grass
all additions inside the original silhouette
must_exclude: creature or egg baked into the bitmap
center circle, platform, plaza, ring, rug, paving, dining floor, path, or indentation
bridges, clouds, readable labels, text, watermark, external shadow
tiny food pieces, tableware clutter, crumbs, steam particles, tiny herbs, flowers, grass blades, pebbles, cracks, specks, or dense texture
